description: Simple Comments works like the standard table visual, with extra columns your team can edit directly in the report. Use it for status updates, notes, approvals, or follow-ups next to your data. Features: Editable cells. Click a cell and type, including multiple lines. Changes save as you type. Dropdowns with colors. Turn a column into a dropdown list and give each value its own text and background color, such as red for Blocked and green for Done. Control who can edit. Add a measure to the Security field to choose which rows each person can edit, or to lock rows such as closed periods. Up to five editable columns (Premium). Each column has its own name, format, and input type. Pro includes one editable column. Comments are stored securely on our service and linked to your license key, so the visual needs an internet connection and a license. Your report data is never sent, only a one-way hash that identifies each row. Try every Premium feature free for 60 days, no card required. Setup takes a few minutes, and your team can start editing today.
